claim_scope: Stateless pose-to-light geometry bundle on fixed saved bodies and simulation mechanics. No new music conditioning, model qualification, preference or hardware claim.
prior_evidence: Unpreregistered proper-FK engineering already shows raw anatomical inversions retained by prototype, fixed-lane saturation, millimetre pair overlaps and shared 3D-to-2D nullspace. New prediction concerns emitted axes/visibility after mechanics on recordings, not these already-seen synthetic facts.
source_selection: Saved prior_native_flow on full Shpongle (not new draw7001); exactly the existing twelve reference mocap review windows as oracle transfer checks. No new inference or selecting among generated models/draws.

primary.statistic: mean across six heads of emitted-axis projected midshaft band RMS / mean projected equivalent half-peak cone-circle radius at midshaft
primary.integration: NEW instrument: trapezoid of piecewise-linear Welch PSD including interpolated exact band edges. Integrate .5 through4.0 inclusive; supplementary adjoining bands partition this power. Do not reuse legacy half-open-bin trapz values.

collapse_instrument.statistic: RMS spread of six emitted first-hit camera-pixel positions about their centroid / mean equivalent relative-half-peak cone radius at the first hits, not midpoint
collapse_instrument.scope: Shpongle active70-90 and each fixed20s reference window; pair convergence is reported but NOT synonymous with all-head collapse. Report x span, intrinsic chart area, camera spread and pair distances separately.

gates.primary: Shpongle active0.5-4Hz motion/radius candidate>=2*matched stage02. New broadband instrument, not reused1-2Hz number.
gates.mechanics: All full-record emitted speed<=90deg/s and acceleration<=360deg/s2, exact decoded DMX; simulator only.
gates.valid: At least.99 full-frame head samples have valid finite-stage first hits; report all10s blocks and camera viewport fractions.
gates.surfaces: Shpongle active floor and wall first-hit fractions each>=.10.
gates.quiet: Shpongle0-20 decoded pan/tilt Euclidean coordinate-speed median over all six heads <=16.3488deg/s (.4*historical40.872). Report matched stage02 quiet speed and difference; this ceiling is not a noninferiority claim.
gates.nonangle: All non-angle DMX bytes identical to the matched same-body stage02 stream before common zero-zoom optical override.
gates.collapse: All-head cloud criterion above; no minimum inter-pair spacing gate. Report genuine overlaps and cone overlap, do not hide them.
gates.oracle_transfer: At least6 of8 fixed travel/coordination reference windows have higher candidate broadband ratio than baseline. Four hold windows are reported but NOT rewarded for more motion. All12 retain mechanics/valid/nonangle/collapse checks and fixed visual selection; no source/seed reselection.
gates.pixels: Outside-bulb any-channel>=250 fraction mean<.01,max<.05 in candidate rendered coverage; report white clipping and sourcebulbs separately.
gates.coverage: If numerical stages pass: all12 fixed reference clips and fullShpongle with shared-body/baseline/candidate panels, full software decode/audio and chronological1Hz+last review with fixedfastsamples. Silent reviews not human acceptance.
gates.brightness: If numerical stages pass: additional fullShpongle globally display-RGB dimmed pair to lower outside-bulb mean; scalars and quantization residuals reported, no framewise matching.

stages_and_early_stop: Synthetic code/IO tests only before freeze; no real candidate mapping.

After registration and source/input/runtime freeze, map and analyze full Shpongle only. If primary, mechanics,valid,surfaces,quiet,nonangle,collapse fails, stop reference-record candidate evaluation and fullmovie expansion. Preserve failure and render ONLY fixed0-20,70-90,190-210 diagnostic clips; no promotion.

If Shpongle numerical gates pass, map complete twelve reference records before slicing fixed20s windows. If oracle_transfer/any per-reference mechanical,valid,nonangle,collapse gate fails: retain all results and render only predetermined holds083,travel027,coordination057 plusShpongle70-90 diagnostics. No fullmovie expansion.

If all numeric stages pass, render all13 planned views, rawpixel controls and globally brightness-matched fullShpongle pair; independent sampled reviews. Any pixel/media gate failure stays a failure; no silent exposure or source changes.
rendering: One shared EGL context, explicit exclusive gpu_lock; software libx264 shared encoding per pair. Raw hashes/metrics and caption provenance. Exact whole-frame audio trim, no silent pose padding.
unavailable_comparators: No legacy incumbent3D lighting; no reference body forShpongle. This is mapper testing, not a new matched-generator study.

clarifications.valid: Global full-record valid head-sample fraction is gated at .99; 10s blocks reported, not additional unregistered per-block thresholds.
clarifications.primary: Mean of six per-head ratios (each RMS divided by that head mean radius), not ratio of grand means.
clarifications.collapse: Only Shpongle70-90 and twelve fixed reference20s windows; mechanics/nonangle/valid use complete records.
clarifications.quiet: Use exact surface_revision.mechanics instrument: decoded pan/tilt degree vector first differences at40Hz, Euclidean norm; median over all six heads/all intervals in0-20s, no lit gating. NOT direction/geodesic speed. Baseline40.872 and cap16.3488 refer to this coordinate-speed instrument.
clarifications.pair_diagnostics: Report equivalent-camera-circle separation d/(r_i+r_j), not true projected ellipse/illumination overlap area. Report Euclidean first-hit separation quantiles/min separately. Intrinsic unfolded floor-wall convex-hull area only when all hits floor/wall; report unsupported/truss count and denominator.
clarifications.numeric_missingness: Nonfinite/incomplete primary geometry may not pass. No silent missing-frame deletion or interpolation. Report unassessed coverage separately from actual collapse.
clarifications.helper_namespace: Helpers must not activate old support-review mapper over the new frozen pose-stage source. Verify actual imported mapper/pose_stage paths and hashes are in new frozen source. Use helper context activation only where explicitly safe; fresh-process namespace smoke test.
clarifications.registration_contract: Parent accepts proposed raw registration.json with hypothesis{id,plan:JSON string or dict},experiment{id,config_note:JSON string or dict},registered_by=parent,registered_before_candidate_execution=true, exact plan equality. No real candidate execution before this receipt and freeze.
clarifications.spectral_edges: Accept exact-edge interpolated trapezoid for NEW broadband and subbands; test power partition. Historical optics1-2Hz values used half-open-bin trapz and are not numerically interchangeable.
clarifications.selected_geometry_validity: Require zero missing/nonfinite first-hit/projection/radius samples in primary and collapse selected windows. Failure is unmeasurable coverage, not an assertion that collapse occurred. Global full-record valid>=.99 may tolerate missingness only outside those selected windows.
clarifications.pair_denominator: Valid-pair denominator only for descriptive pair statistics, with explicit invalid counts. No pair spacing gate.
